Saved CanvasViews: named branches through one canvas history
|
+-- CanvasHistoryRecord.canvasViews stores the view graph
|   +-- saved[id] -> CanvasView
|   |   +-- checkpointIds: the view's pinned trail
|   |   |   +-- startCheckpointId: comparison baseline
|   |   |   `-- finalCheckpointId: latest saved endpoint
|   |   +-- parentViewId: ancestry
|   |   |   `-- forkCheckpointId: exact point inherited from parent
|   |   `-- alternativeGroupId: marks sibling candidates
|   `-- activeViewId + workingCopies[id]
|       `-- unsaved edits survive switching between views
|
+-- CanvasHistory.canvasView() changes the graph
|   +-- create: save the current head as a new active view
|   +-- Branch from a parent's saved endpoint
|   |   +-- fork: create and open one child
|   |   `-- alternatives: create sibling copies without switching
|   +-- Work on a branch
|   |   +-- open: stash the old head, restore the target as a new snapshot
|   |   |   `-- retain the current camera position
|   |   `-- save: pin the new endpoint and clear its working copy
|   `-- Resolve branches
|       +-- keep: save the choice; archive group siblings and descendants
|       `-- discard: archive the selected view and its descendants
|
`-- Checks and presentation
    +-- validateCanvasViews(): check references, checkpoints, and ancestry
    +-- CanvasViewReceiver.apply(): versioned requests and retryable receipts
    +-- CanvasViewControls: show the non-archived ancestry tree and dirty state
    `-- canvasViewComparison(): compare pinned start and final endpoints
